slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the number of trained pilots produced in a given year equal to the number of fighter jets allocated to training in that year, or is there a different conversion rate or delay between jets allocated and pilots actually trained?
slot_scores.rationale: The question explicitly asks about the conversion rate between training jets and pilots trained per year, eliciting the per-jet training capacity.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or about any pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Do the 5 pilots trained by a jet in a given year become available in that same year, or do they become available in the following year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about availability timing but did not ask when training starts or how many years it lasts, leaving the start/duration aspect unconfirmed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training starts in year 1 and continues through year 2, so training allocations in both years contribute to the total trained pilots by the end of year 2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask about the training start year or duration; it inferred the two-year training timeline from the objective horizon and production years.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 training-capacity slot was resolved, but the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL without fully confirming the P1 training start/duration slot.

summary: The agent successfully clarified the key per-jet training capacity but stopped with the training timeline only partially addressed and never asked about the pilot-to-combat-jet mapping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
